title: New License Plate Reader Tech Could Track Phones, AirPods, and Smartwatches
summary: Defense contractor Leonardo is marketing SignalTrace, an ALPR upgrade that pairs license plate detection with Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, and RFID signal capture to link vehicles with nearby devices like phones, AirPods, and smartwatches. The article raises privacy concerns and notes cybersecurity risks similar to prior vulnerabilities found in Motorola's Vigilant ALPR system.

key_quotes.quote: SignalTrace adds a second layer of intelligence to existing license plate reader networks by combining vehicle detections with nearby Bluetooth , Wi-Fi, and Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) broadcasts.

Leonardo says SignalTrace does not decrypt or read data stored on the devices it detects. Instead, the system captures wireless signatures, classifies them by device type, associates them with nearby vehicles, and stores the resulting records for investigators.
